name: Märklin C-Track
description: Märklin's current H0 3-rail track system with integrated plastic roadbed, introduced 1996. Stud-contact center conductor (Märklin's signature 3-rail AC system). Named radii: R1=360 mm, R2=437.5 mm, R3=515 mm, R4=579.3 mm, R5=643.6 mm, R9 (wide curves) = 1114.6 mm. Standard arc fractions: 30°, 24.282°, 15°, 7.5°, 5.722°. Common straight is 24172 (188.3 mm). Article numbers are five-digit Märklin SKUs in the 24xxx series. Note: C-Track is the current production system. Predecessors are M-Track (older 3-rail with stamped-metal roadbed, 5xxx SKUs) and K-Track (3-rail without roadbed, 22xx/23xx SKUs); none are interchangeable without adapter pieces.

pieces.label: Straight 94.2 mm
pieces.notes: Half-length straight; pairs with R1 30° curve to keep parallel-track centerlines aligned in standard geometry.

pieces.label: Straight 77.5 mm
pieces.notes: Compensating straight, used to keep parallel-track spacing in turnout/crossover geometries.

pieces.label: Straight 70.8 mm
pieces.notes: Compensating straight matched to slim-turnout geometry.

pieces.label: Straight 57.5 mm
pieces.notes: Compensating straight for parallel-track alignment with slim turnouts.

pieces.label: Straight 108.8 mm
pieces.notes: Compensating straight matched to standard turnout geometry.

pieces.label: Straight 188.3 mm
pieces.notes: Standard full-length straight (same length as 24172 but a different SKU/variant in catalog history; sources occasionally treat 24188 and 24172 as the same standard 180 mm-class piece — see notes file).

pieces.label: Straight 180 mm
pieces.notes: Standard straight, 180 mm. Also sold in package 24171 (older). The default 'unit' straight in C-Track planning.

pieces.label: Straight 229.3 mm
pieces.notes: Long compensating straight for crossover/yard geometry.

pieces.label: Straight 236 mm
pieces.notes: Long straight, often used for station platforms.

pieces.label: Straight 360 mm
pieces.notes: Extra-long straight, primarily for stations and main lines.

pieces.label: Adjustable fitter straight 70-110 mm
pieces.notes: Adjustable / extendable fitter piece used to close geometry gaps; nominal range approximately 70-110 mm. Length stored as null because user must set it.

pieces.label: Curve R1 360 mm, 30°
pieces.notes: R1 = 360 mm. 12 pieces of this curve form a full circle (12 × 30° = 360°). Arc length = 2π × 360 × 30/360 = 188.50 mm.

pieces.label: Curve R1 360 mm, 15°
pieces.notes: R1 half-curve (15°). Arc length = 2π × 360 × 15/360 = 94.25 mm.

pieces.label: Curve R2 437.5 mm, 15°
pieces.notes: R2 half-curve. Arc length = 2π × 437.5 × 15/360 = 114.54 mm.

pieces.label: Curve R2 437.5 mm, 7.5°
pieces.notes: R2 quarter-curve. Used for fine-grain alignment with turnouts.

pieces.label: Curve R3 515 mm, 15°
pieces.notes: R3 half-curve. Arc length = 2π × 515 × 15/360 = 134.79 mm.

pieces.label: Curve R4 579.3 mm, 15°
pieces.notes: R4 half-curve. Used to nest with R3 for parallel-track-spacing transitions.

pieces.label: Curve R4 579.3 mm, 24.282°
pieces.notes: R4 24.282° curve — matches the standard turnout (24611/24612) divergence angle. Arc length = 2π × 579.3 × 24.282/360 ≈ 245.45 mm.

pieces.label: Wide-radius curve (R9 1114.6 mm) 5.722°
pieces.notes: R9 = 1114.6 mm wide-radius curve, 5.722°. Used for high-speed mainline appearance and as part of slim turnout (24711/24712) geometry. Note: Märklin lists the 'wide radius' as approximately 1114.6 mm; some catalog reprints round to 1115 mm.

pieces.label: Standard left turnout (R2 437.5 mm, 24.282°)
pieces.notes: Standard left turnout. Main route is straight 188.3 mm; diverging route is R2 (437.5 mm) for 24.282°. Frog 'number' not published in Märklin convention; left null.

pieces.label: Standard right turnout (R2 437.5 mm, 24.282°)
pieces.notes: Standard right turnout. Mirror of 24611.

pieces.label: Slim left turnout (R9 1114.6 mm, 12.1°)
pieces.notes: Slim (long) left turnout. Diverging route uses R9 wide radius (1114.6 mm). Overall length 236.1 mm along main route. Divergence ~12.1°.

pieces.label: Slim right turnout (R9 1114.6 mm, 12.1°)
pieces.notes: Slim (long) right turnout. Mirror of 24711.

pieces.label: Three-way turnout
pieces.notes: Three-way turnout: one straight + two diverging routes (left & right) at R2 437.5 mm / 24.282°. Same overall main-route length as standard turnout.

pieces.label: Double-slip switch
pieces.notes: Double-slip / English crossing. Connects two crossing tracks at 24.282°. Overall length 188.3 mm matches standard turnout.

pieces.label: Curved left turnout (R2/R3)
pieces.notes: Curved left turnout: outer route R3 515 mm / 30°, inner route R2 437.5 mm / 24.282°. Length stored is the outer (longer) route arc. CAVEAT: curved turnouts are inherently asymmetric — single 'overall_length_mm' is an approximation; gap solver should treat both branches separately when needed.

pieces.label: Curved right turnout (R2/R3)
pieces.notes: Curved right turnout, mirror of 24671.

pieces.label: Crossing 24.282°
pieces.notes: Crossing at 24.282° (matches standard turnout angle). Overall length on main 188.3 mm.

pieces.label: Crossing 90°
pieces.notes: Right-angle crossing. Confirm exact SKU against current Märklin catalog; some sources list 24649, others 24640 variants.

pieces.label: Electric uncoupler track 94.2 mm
pieces.notes: Electromagnetic uncoupler track, half-straight length (94.2 mm).

pieces.label: Rerailer / re-railer track 188.3 mm
pieces.notes: Re-railing piece; full-straight length (188.3 mm).

pieces.label: Bumper / end track
pieces.notes: End-of-track bumper. Length 77.5 mm matches the 24077 compensating straight.

pieces.label: Transition C-Track to K-Track
pieces.notes: Transition piece with C-Track roadbed at one end and K-Track sectional rail profile at the other. Length 111 mm is approximate (various catalogs list 110-112 mm).

pieces.label: Transition C-Track to M-Track
pieces.notes: Transition C-Track to legacy M-Track. Length is approximate; see notes file. Caveat: M-Track transition pieces have appeared under multiple SKUs (24922, 24921) over time.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/marklin-c-track.md for per-system caveats.
